name: TestCo

rules.text: Body text must hit at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background; use Ink Black on white or white on Signal Blue, never Slate Gray on Cloud Gray.
Signal Blue or Ember Orange may cover no more than 15% of any layout; keep the field neutral white or cloud.
Headlines use sentence case in Archivo; never all-caps beyond a single short word.
Each composition carries exactly one call-to-action button in Signal Blue with white label text.
Do not apply gradients, glows, or drop shadows to text or buttons; flat fills only.

voice: Direct, confident, and plainspoken — we explain rather than impress, and we never use filler. Short declarative sentences, active verbs, zero jargon. Example taglines: "TestCo. Built to be tested." / "Proof, not promises."

archetypes.label: Card with bold headline + CTA pill, logo bottom-left
Full-bleed photo, headline top, CTA + logo bottom
Typographic poster on a flat brand ground

examples: Full-page white ad with a single Archivo sentence-case headline in Ink Black, one line of Inter body copy, and a Signal Blue CTA button in the lower left.
Split layout: left half Cloud Gray with a product close-up, right half white with a short proof-point headline and one Ember Orange stat number.
Minimal social square: white background, three-word Archivo headline, small Inter subline, and a thin Signal Blue rule under the headline.
